errors.UNAUTHORIZED: The API key is missing, unknown or revoked.
errors.FORBIDDEN_SCOPE: This API key may not do this.
errors.CUSTOM_PRICE_FORBIDDEN: A price other than the customer's own price needs the price permission.
errors.SALE_HAS_RETURNS: A sale with returns cannot be cancelled.
errors.SALE_IS_VOID: A cancelled sale cannot take a return.
errors.FITMENT_EXISTS: This part is already linked to this vehicle.
errors.IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED: This Idempotency-Key was already used with a different request.
errors.ACCOUNT_REQUIRED: Several accounts take this payment method; name one.
errors.ACCOUNT_INVALID: This account is inactive or of another kind.
errors.CHEQUE_DETAILS_REQUIRED: A cheque needs its bank, number and due date.
errors.PAYMENTS_EXCEED_TOTAL: The payments add up to more than the total.
errors.WALK_IN_CANNOT_HAVE_DUE: A sale without a customer cannot leave a due.
errors.PAYMENT_EXCEEDS_DUE: The payment is more than the customer's due.
errors.DISCOUNT_TOO_HIGH: The discount is more than the subtotal.
errors.PART_NOT_AVAILABLE: This part is no longer in the catalog.
errors.RETURN_QTY_TOO_HIGH: More is returned than was sold on this line.
errors.RETURN_REFUND_REQUIRED: Say how the return is refunded: how much from the due and how much in cash.
errors.RETURN_REFUND_MISMATCH: The two refund parts do not add up to the return's total.
errors.REFUND_DUE_EXCEEDS_BALANCE: More would be taken off the due than the customer owes.
errors.VOID_EXCEEDS_DUE: A payment came in after this sale, so it cannot be cancelled; record a return instead.
errors.REVERSAL_EXCEEDS_PAYABLE: A payment was made after this purchase, so it cannot be reversed.

warnings.LOW_STOCK: The stock of a part goes below zero.
warnings.OVER_CREDIT_LIMIT: The customer's due is now over the credit limit.
warnings.INACTIVE_PART: A part marked inactive was sold.
warnings.TRX_ID_MISSING: A mobile payment has no transaction ID.
warnings.AVG_COST_KEPT: The part was bought or sold since, so its average cost stays as it is.
